terra.problem: The psalm does not say the fathers’ only job was to be set down in the land. That adds a detail about their role.
The cookie-on-a-tray joke makes light of a verse about peoples being crushed and driven out.
The recipe joke follows the statement that the peoples were crushed and cast out, making light of their suffering.
“Not even close” is a dismissive reaction to the baker’s answer.
“They have nothing to hide” goes beyond the psalm’s specific claim about forgetting God or reaching out to a foreign god.
“Hear them hugging the ground” is an illogical, lighthearted image applied to the people’s distress.
